description: Hand-written recording (spec §9 replay; no model key was available to record live with RECORD=1) for the M2 pizza loop: Dana asks for two pizzas; the planner reads the Budapest pizza shop's storefront menu (search_catalog 'bud') and proposes 2 x Margherita at the menu price. propose_order turns the shop's own SKUs and prices into the signed fulfillment (itemsHash in the CanonicalOrder); after the passkey approval the one-time card is handed to the shop, which charges it once and reports the order status to Kassa. Placeholders: the user text names no payee; the shop's payee becomes payee_1 in the search_catalog result (first placeholder of the conversation).

steps.text: Let me check the pizza shop's menu.

I've drafted 2 Margherita pizzas from payee_1 for 5,980 Ft at the shop's menu price. Approve it with your passkey: Kassa then issues a one-time card for exactly this amount and this shop, the shop charges it once, and you can follow the order from received to delivered here. A second charge on that card is declined.
